notes: R-INF_PLT-1 represents the main deliberate defensive position near Narrow Bridge and attempts to delay or block the BLUE battalion.
R-INF_PLT-2 represents positions in depth on Sanctuary Ridge, including machine-gun support for the main defensive position.
R-RIFLE_SQD-1 represents the economy-of-force screen or guard protecting Western Narrow Pass.
R-TANK_PLT-1 represents the enemy armoured reserve assessed to be north of Sanctuary Ridge.

The armoured reserve receives the identity of B-INF_BN-1 as its counterattack objective but receives no target_position and therefore must rely on perceived or shared Tracks rather than BLUE Ground Truth.
Exact RED force composition and locations are inferred from the TDG solution and are not explicitly specified by the source.
